caption: The drawing depicts a brown cow standing on a rectangular wooden platform. The cow is shown in profile view, facing left, and has a short coat of light brown fur with a slightly lighter underside. Its head features two short, dark brown or black horns, a pink nose, visible ears, and a large black collar around its neck with a metal bell attached. The cow's udder, visible and pinkish, is positioned near its hind legs. The tail hangs down and ends with a tuft of dark hair. The hooves are dark and the legs are thin, each hoof distinctly outlined. The wooden base the cow is standing on is rectangular with visible wood grain and shaded in brown and reddish hues, and includes a metal ring and hook attached near the edges. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or scenery present.
title: Toy Cow on Stand
